identity: Ashenward March is the Accord's supply road to the front: a crooked quartermaster sells the rations, the ash woods walk at night, and a poacher marshal sells the March's game back to the army it was meant to feed.

quests.title: Three Crates Out, Two Crates In
quests.text: Every third ration crate vanishes between the storehouse and the line, and my cooks are running out of ways to call hot water supper. Defeat five Ration Robbers at the {name:ration_camp} {dir_from_giver:ration_camp}, where our missing meals have found an appreciative audience. Someone is keeping those thieves very well supplied.
quests.lesson: A bandit camp in the first belt.

quests.title: The Trees Can Pay for That
quests.text: At night, Charred Oaks roam the {name:cinderwood}, which lies {zone_area:cinderwood}, and they've been knocking my water carts to pieces. Fell five and bring me two lumps of Bitter Resin from them for the barrel repairs. If the woods insist on joining this war, they can contribute to the supply bill.
quests.lesson: Kill and drop request from the same outing.

quests.title: The Account of {name:quartermaster_scrip}
quests.text: Our own supply seal is on those stolen crates: {name:quartermaster_scrip} has been selling the line's supper out from under it. Find the quartermaster at the {name:ration_camp} {dir_from_giver:quartermaster_scrip} and defeat them. There are soldiers scraping empty bowls while that ledger balances beautifully.
quests.lesson: Normal named leader; the climax resolves the first quest's theft.

quests.title: Bread for the Mountain Watch
quests.text: Take word to Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights: the March road is clear and his supplies can move again. Ask what needs doing while you're there; Borin won't send a useful pair of hands home idle. Between his passes and Faeris's woods in Glassroot Wilds, there's work enough for both journeys.
quests.lesson: Contested circuit: the three zones carry the band together.

quests.title: An Answer for Faeris
quests.text: Faeris Rootbinder at Glassroot Gate in Glassroot Wilds has had nothing from my carts lately but apologies. Tell her the barrels are rolling again, and ask where she needs help. I've work for you in Stormvault Heights as well; the forest and the mountain are keeping this same army on its feet.
quests.lesson: Contested circuit: the three zones carry the band together.

quests.title: One More Pair of Hands
quests.text: Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt keeps the last post before the front standing by sheer refusal to leave it. Report to her when you're ready for the harder fighting. Her last request was for timber, food and people who could think on their feet; I can at least send her you.
quests.lesson: Handoff to the zone's second outpost and its harder ground.

quests.title: Bounty: No Rations for the Dead
quests.text: Every night, Bone Levies haunt the ration road through the {name:ashfields}, which lie {zone_area:ashfields}, though not one of them has a stomach left to fill. Break six of them after dark so my drivers can deliver supper to someone who'll eat it. This bounty is repeatable, twenty minutes after you turn it in.
quests.lesson: Optional repeatable hunt.

quests.title: Honey Is Not Worth a Driver
quests.text: The Bruins in the {name:hedgewood}, which lies {zone_area:hedgewood}, have learned to follow our wagons by daylight. They're after the honey, but the drivers get the claws. Kill four of the bears; I can replace a jar, and I'm tired of writing letters about people I can't.
quests.lesson: Heavy hitters by day in the middle belt.

quests.title: Webs Across the Wagon Road
quests.text: With the bears thinned, Ash Widows take the {name:hedgewood} at night and string our wagon road shut, horses and all. Kill four of them after dark. Cut the drivers loose first if you find any; the spiders will wait, they always do.
quests.lesson: Same wood, night roster: the middle belt holds the hedge line between 34 and 37.

quests.title: A Uniform Is Not a Target
quests.text: Hedge Bowmen at {name:coalbrand_yard} {dir_from_giver:coalbrand_yard} have taken to using our dispatch runners for target practice. Defeat five of them and give the runners room to breathe. Keep low on the approach; I'd rather read your report than have you delivered as one.
quests.lesson: Ranged camp at the top of the zone.

quests.title: The Price of an Empty Pot
quests.text: Wartrail Poachers at the {name:poacher_camp} {dir_from_giver:poacher_camp} take the March's game, then charge our cooks whatever desperation will bear. Defeat five of them and break their hold on the hunting grounds. Their marshal signs every sale, as though neat handwriting could make this honest.
quests.lesson: Second camp of the top belt; seeds the group climax.

quests.title: Party: The Last Receipt
quests.text: {name:red_receipt_marshal} still runs the trade from the {name:poacher_camp} {dir_from_giver:red_receipt_marshal}, signing away our soldiers' supper in red ink. Gather a party and kill the elite marshal; I've written enough letters this season without starting one about you. Bring everyone back, and the first supper he can no longer sell is yours.
quests.lesson: Elite climax for a group; the route reaches 40 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: Let the Watch Come Home
quests.text: After dark, Trench Shamblers cross the {name:warfields}, which lie {zone_area:warfields}, and every returning patrol has to fight through them. Put down eight at night so I can count my soldiers through the gate instead of wondering. This bounty becomes available again twenty-five minutes after you turn it in.
quests.lesson: Optional repeatable hunt.

quests.title: Bring Me the Account
quests.text: A Causeway convoy's pay was impounded at {name:r20_anchor_071}, {dir_from_giver:r20_anchor_071}, and the clerk who sealed it will not go near it again: the purse is still warm. Unseal it and take what you find to Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch; the pay was meant for his drivers. Bring me the account. I already have enough accusations.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 1 (41): the Warmaster's first order; a use at Ashenward March's clash site, turned in at Cinderline Watch.

quests.title: The Price of a Salute
quests.text: The Throng's seal warrants an inquiry; an Undead body proves nothing about who paid it. Nella Hedgeward reports that the dead on The Shattered Line rally to a standard pledged against the same warm coin. Defeat three Brandbound Collectors after dark in the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/trenches}, and unpick the pledged standard at {name:r20_anchor_082}. Report to Nella at Last Hedge Redoubt with what the stitching reveals.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 2 (46): the opener; a corrupted sub-type in the Shattered Line trenches by night and a use at its clash site, turned in at Last Hedge Redoubt.

quests.title: Read Before Accusing
quests.text: Ninepins pledged his standard against the next payment, and The Throng's high war camp sits on the same line, but a seal does not tell us whose hand pressed it. Defeat {captain:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high} at the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}, and bring me the Throng Captain's Orders. I want their own words before I accuse them of anything.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 2 (47): behind the lines, solo; the captain of the enemy war camp on The Shattered Line drops his orders (quest drop).

quests.title: A Quiet Audit
quests.text: Their orders hunt the same soot factors and list their own soldiers burned by the seized pay, which came wrapped in genuine Ashenward requisitions countersigned by Requisition Clerk Odren Vell. The false seal of The Throng was stamped on our own paper. This finding stays under seal; The Throng must not learn whose office supplied it. Copy Vell's courier ledger at {name:elandor_glassroot_wilds/couriers_stump}, {dir_of:r20_anchor_036:elandor_glassroot_wilds/couriers_stump}, bring the copy to me and nobody else, and come back for your next orders when you can hold your own on Gravesalt's salt.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 2 (last turn-in): the traitor named; a use at Glassroot Wilds' quest place.

quests.title: Following Vell's Pay
quests.text: Odren Vell took over the convoy books after Quartermaster Scrip fell, then left last season 'to settle arrears', without saying whose. His courier ledger traces branded pay to the Saltroad Deserters in Gravesalt Escarpment, whose Debtjaw Hounds carry the same ember stain. Kill four Debtjaw Hounds by day in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tombwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tombwood}. Report to Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights; he is following the payments into the Last Watch.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 3 (53): the Warmaster's opener, a corrupted sub-type in the Tombwood by day, turned in at Splitbolt Station.

quests.title: Party: Stonegrudge's Inquiry
quests.text: The captain's orders put War Commander Stonegrudge in charge of The Throng's hunt for the factors, from the {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}. A rival inquiry is no invitation to share intelligence, least of all one heading for our requisition office. Gather a party and defeat him among his garrison; he is an elite commander, and I expect a plan that accounts for everyone coming back.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite: the war commander the orders name, at his camp's level (raids there open at 57).

quests.title: Party: The Collector Comes Due
quests.text: I entered Odren Vell in the Bastion's roll anyway, with the cause beside his name: "Every name accounted for. His too." Gather a party of two or three and defeat Isquarre the Tithe-Eater at {name:r20_anchor_077}, {dir_from_giver:r20_anchor_077}, where the unsecured debt has given its collector a body of slag and ash. Secure the site before The Throng claims authority over it; our own account of this affair will remain under seal.
quests.lesson: Main line, the finale (60): the rift boss at Tombroad Ambush, for a group of two or three.

quests.title: Every Name Accounted For
quests.text: Isquarre broke at {name:r20_anchor_077}, but the crack did not, and a collector who loses his body keeps the debt. I have sealed your report with the names you brought back, the clerk's among them. We closed his account. Beneath us, someone turned a fresh page.
quests.lesson: Main line, the last Warmaster turn-in (the achievement counts this id).
